response.sql: WITH source_stats AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS source_size, AVG(1.0 * s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(source_size) AS avg_size FROM source_stats) SELECT AVG(ss.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio, SUM(ss.source_size) AS combined_size, AVG(ss.source_size - b.avg_size) AS avg_excess_size FROM source_stats AS ss CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE ss.source_size > b.avg_size;

assumptions.assumption: Size means the number of spatial scan records per funding source, including records with missing box dimensions. A zero box Z cannot produce a ratio. Each funding source, including NULL, has equal weight in the final average of source ratios.

alternatives.interpretation: Size means the number of distinct projects represented in the spatial scan data per funding source.
alternatives.sql: WITH source_stats AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS source_size, AVG(1.0 * s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(source_size) AS avg_size FROM source_stats) SELECT AVG(ss.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio, SUM(ss.source_size) AS combined_size, AVG(ss.source_size - b.avg_size) AS avg_excess_size FROM source_stats AS ss CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE ss.source_size > b.avg_size;
